caption: The drawing consists of two objects positioned vertically on an off-white background. The top object is a circular lid or decorated dish cover, featuring ornate floral and leaf designs in relief, with a central flower motif and intricate patterns around the edge; an attached handle-like extension with additional ornamental carvings can be seen on the left side, and two small protruding elements appear at the top right and bottom right edges. The lower object is a round, flat disk seen from above, plain except for inscriptions. The inscriptions read: at the top edge, "J.E. CALDWELL & CO.;" in larger script in the center, "Mary Stewart 1879;" at the bottom edge, "STERLING 789." The artist's signature, "F.J. HASTINGS," is present near the lower right side of the disk. The entire composition is rendered in shades of gray such as would appear in a pencil or graphite drawing, with careful attention to highlights and shadows to give the objects a metallic appearance.
title: Silver Chocolate Pot
